notes.note: T1: overlay checked; finger, three knuckles, bent thumb, open wrist, ring and rays match; sheet strokes run heavier than W

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at the set line weight W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. This icon is the heaviest of its row: median 6.04 px, the ring 6.2 to 6.3 px. That is why the silhouette IoU (0.87) and ink ratio (0.90) sit low while the centrelines match.

source_notes: Pillar mark (DR-04). Kept: the long upright index finger inside the ring, its right side ending open at y 83.4 below the first knuckle; the knuckle count of three, stepping down to the right; the bent thumb hooking up and back to meet the finger's left side at y 98.5, with the finger's side running on to a small point at y 103.1; both wrist ends open (x 36.2 and 86.3 at y 141). The ring stays off-centre from the fingertip by 1.8 px, as drawn. The three rays keep their drawn angles and lengths (upper -30 deg, middle level, lower 33.6 deg; the lower ray sits a little further from the middle one than the upper). Red is the ring and the three rays; the finger and hand stay black; both sheets agree.
